title: The Duel: Timo Boll vs. KUKA Robot
summary: A KUKA commercial staging a table tennis match between German star Timo Boll and a KUKA KR AGILUS industrial robot. It is a polished showcase of robot speed and precision.
why: HN links it as the go-to example of fast robot reactions and robots playing table tennis, with some skepticism that it was staged marketing.

quote.text: Kuka had this demo years ago
